personal.name: Mohamed Elnagar
personal.heroSubtitle: Skilled Android Developer with hands-on experience delivering production-grade applications from concept through deployment. Proficient in Kotlin, Room, Paging, Hilt, and Firebase services.
personal.contactHeadline: I’m always open to discussing new opportunities, collaborations, or simply connecting with like-minded people. Feel free to reach out via any of the platforms below!

paragraphs: Hello! I'm Mohamed Elnagar, a skilled Android Developer dedicated to building high-performance, production-grade mobile applications.

With expertise in Kotlin, Jetpack Components, and Hilt, I specialize in delivering robust solutions from concept to deployment. I have a strong focus on Clean Architecture, MVVM, and writing maintainable, testable code.

My experience includes developing complex systems like medical record management, retail POS solutions, and productivity tools. I am passionate about continuous learning and staying ahead of modern Android development trends like Coroutines (Flow/StateFlow) and Paging.
When I'm not coding, I focus on software engineering best practices, exploring multimodule architectures, and refining user experiences through intuitive design and performance optimization.

projects.title: Fard (Islamic Productivity App)
projects.description: A comprehensive spiritual tool designed for tracking obligations and spiritual growth using Modular Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design.
features: Modular Clean Architecture with 100% testable codebase
Global Time Automation engine for prayer sync (DST & Timezones)
System-level media service for background audio & lock-screen controls
Multi-engine Quran reader (Vector text & Image-based mushaf)
Performance tuned for 60fps animations & hardware-haptic feedback

projects.title: DrAiA (Medical Sessions)
projects.description: Patient record management system for ophthalmology, handling exams, diagnoses, and shared treatments.
features: Patient history and ophthalmology-specific lens data management
Automated PDF/Image generation for session summaries
Integrated WhatsApp sharing for medical reports
Shared codebase with OptPos using Product Flavors

projects.title: Employee Attendance System
projects.description: Advanced tracking system with deep Excel integration for enterprise data portability.
features: Robust Excel data import/export with complex validation logic
Configurable holiday/weekend logic for working-day calculations
Reactive UI architecture using StateFlow and SafeArgs navigation
Detailed reporting with rejection reason logging

projects.title: OptPos (Retail Management)
projects.description: Seller operations tool for billing, registration, and inventory tracking with secure authentication.
features: Secure One-Tap registration with Google Credentials API
Real-time billing and invoice processing engine
Seller performance analytics and activity tracking

tasks: Designed and developed **Medical Sessions App (DrAiA)** and **Seller Management App (OptPos)** from scratch
Implemented clean, scalable solutions using **multimodule architecture** and product flavors
Applied Kotlin, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Room, MySQL, Paging, Coroutines, and Flow
Engineered automated PDF/Image report generation for instant medical record sharing
Maintained existing search engine apps with high performance and Paging support
Developed a complete **Employee Attendance Management System** with complex Excel integration
Built validation engines for data import using Apache POI with detailed rejection reporting
Utilized reactive state management (StateFlow) and SafeArgs for crash-resistant navigation
Designed and implemented configurable business logic for holiday and weekend working-day calculations
